title: tests/integration/oidc35_onboarding_test.zig does not compile: struct literals stale against current AuthContext (missing 'principal', ISS-403) and OnboardingInput (missing 'tenant_type'/'production_tenant_id', ENV-01) shapes
resolution: Both fix components confirmed already applied by ISS-0137/GH#439 work: (1) AuthContext.principal field added to makeAuthContext() in test file; (2) OnboardingInput.tenant_type/.production_tenant_id fields added to both OnboardingInput literals. Build wiring gap (ISS-0102/GH#360) also already resolved — file is in tests/integration/main_test.zig. zig build and zig build test both exit 0. No code changes required in WF03-GH361.
notes: Discovered while implementing ISS-0100 (GitHub #357) Iteration 4 (oidc12/15/35 inline-occurrence fixture hygiene fix), during isolated `zig build` verification of the 3 files touched by that iteration. oidc12 and oidc15 compiled cleanly in isolation once given a minimal correct module set; oidc35 failed with 15 compile errors, none involving the tenant fixture INSERTs this fix touched (lines 739/796/806). The real errors are: (1) `bpm.api_auth.AuthContext{...}` literals at oidc35 lines 98 and elsewhere omit the `principal` field, which `src/api/middleware/auth.zig`'s `AuthContext` struct (line 160) has required since ISS-403's rate-limiting keying work; (2) `onboarding_mod.OnboardingInput{...}` literals at lines 460 and 541 omit `tenant_type`/`production_tenant_id`, which `src/identity/onboarding.zig`'s `OnboardingInput` struct (line 89) has required since ENV-01. Confirmed via `git show HEAD:tests/integration/oidc35_onboarding_test.zig` that these struct literals are byte-identical to the version before the ISS-0100 iteration-4 edit -- the breakage predates this fix and is unrelated to it. This is consistent with, and a concrete confirmation of, ISS-0102's (GitHub #360) finding that oidc12/15/35 (and oidc09/10/11) are wired into no build target at all: because nothing ever compiles this file, its drift against AuthContext/OnboardingInput's evolving shape went undetected through at least two intervening feature additions (ISS-403, ENV-01).
candidate_resolution: Once ISS-0102's wiring gap is resolved for oidc35 (adding it to tests/integration/main_test.zig or a dedicated build.zig test step), the build will surface these compile errors directly and BACKEND-DEV can update the two struct literals: add `.principal = <matching value>` to the AuthContext literal(s) (likely reusing token_id or a fixed test principal string, consistent with how other integration tests construct AuthContext for PLATFORM_ADMIN/bootstrap actors), and add `.tenant_type = .production` (or `.test` as appropriate per call site) plus `.production_tenant_id = null` (or a real UUID for .test) to both OnboardingInput literals. This is a small, mechanical fix once the file is actually reachable by the build graph -- bundling it with ISS-0102's fix is the natural sequencing, since fixing the struct literals without also fixing the wiring gap would leave the fix itself unverified by CI, same problem ISS-0102 already describes.
